The '''Sweet Gem Berry''' is a [[Crops|crop]] that grows from a [[Rare Seed]] after 24 days. It is not considered a [[Fruits|Fruit]] or [[Vegetables|Vegetable]] and cannot be used in a [[Keg]], [[Preserves Jar]], or [[Dehydrator]], nor does it benefit from the [[Farming#Farming Skill|Tiller profession]].

[[Rare Seed]]s can be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Price|1000}} in [[Spring]] & [[Summer]], or for {{tprice|200}} in any season. A [[Seed Maker]] can also produce Rare Seeds from a Sweet Gem Berry.

Despite its high sell price, the berry is regarded as a [[Friendship#Universal Neutrals|neutral gift]] by all the NPCs in [[Stardew Valley]]. When given to [[Old Master Cannoli]] in the [[Secret Woods]], the player receives a [[Stardrop]] in return. In [[multiplayer]], all players receive a Stardrop with the gift of a single berry.

==Bundles==
Sweet Gem Berry is one of the options for the {{bundle|rare crops||y}}.

==Recipes==
Sweet Gem Berry is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Sweet Gem Berry is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|White Turban|class=inline}}.  It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Sweet Gem Berry is not used in any [[quests]].
